name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.7 degrees north of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 5 visits over 39 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 30 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 39 hours starting 2025-06-30, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.72 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
